variants.label: Rolling Hills (default)
variants.blurb: The component's original body — quintic FBM with shear, from kernel biome-rolling-hills.

variants.label: River Valley
variants.blurb: Cheap 6-octave offset FBM from kernel biome-river-valley — a shallower carve with a tinted channel at the lowest ground.

variants.label: Mountain Peaks
variants.blurb: Domain-warped 8-octave ridged FBM from kernel biome-mountain-peaks — about 5x the noise evaluations of Rolling Hills per pixel. Applies only on explicit click.
